Medical conditions:
The medical condition we are investigating is type 1 AMI (STEMI and NSTEMI).  Ziltivekimab is a human monoclonal antibody directed against the interleukin-6 (IL-6) ligand, and currently available clinical data support that ziltivekimab once-monthly reduces inflammation as measured by highsensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP).
